title: Oocyte production from mouse pluripotent stem cells in culture
protocol: Sort BV-positive PGCLCs differentiated from ESCs or iPSCs by FACSAria II.
Centrifuge PGCLCs, remove supernatant and resuspend with appropriate volume of GK15 supplemented with 1 μM retinoic acid.
Dissect female gonads from E12.5 embryos.
Dissociate gonads by treating with 0.05% trypsin.
Purify E12.5 female gonadal somatic cells by incubation with SSEA1 and CD31 antibodies conjugated with magnetic beads.
Separate purified cells through a MACS MS column according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Centrifuge gonadal somatic cells, remove supernatants.
Resuspend cells in GK15 supplemented with 1 µM retinoic acid.
Aggregate 5,000 PGCLCs with 50,000 E12.5 gonadal somatic cells in a low-binding U-bottom 96-well plate in GK15 supplemented with 1 µM retinoic acid.
Place the aggregated cells in a CO₂ incubator and culture for 2 days.
Set a Transwell-COL on a 6 well plate and soak it with αMEM-based IVDi medium.
Transfer rOvaries from the 96-well plates to the Transwell-COL using a glass pipette.
Place the transferred ovaries in a CO₂ incubator.
Change the medium at 2 days of culture.
At 4 days of culture, change half the volume of the medium to StemPro-34-based IVDi medium.
Change half the volume of the medium to fresh StemPro-34-based IVDi medium every other day starting from day 4.
Add 500 nM ICI182780 to the StemPro-34-based IVDi medium from days 7 to 10.
At 21 days of culture, isolate individual follicles from aggregates.
Carefully remove interstitial cells between follicles using a tungsten needle.
Place isolated follicles on Transwell-COL with space between each follicle.
Maintain plate warm on heat plate during isolation.
After isolating all follicles, place Transwell-COL in IVG medium within a 6-well plate.
Add 1 ml of collagenase solution to follicles after 2 days of culture.
Incubate for 10-20 minutes at 37°C.
Wash follicles three times with collagenase wash medium.
Place Transwell-COL on IVG medium without BMP15 and GDF9 in a 6-well plate.
Pour gently IVG medium without BMP15 and GDF9 to cover the follicles on Transwell-COL.
Culture plate in CO2 incubator.
Change half volume of IVG medium without BMP15 and GDF9 every other day for 11 days.
After 11 days, pick cumulus-oocyte complexes (COCs) up using a fine glass capillary.
Transfer COCs into 500 µl IVM medium covered with paraffin liquid in a 4-well dish.
Place 4-well dish in CO2 incubator for culture.
Culture for 16 hours.
Add 25 μl hyaluronidase solution to the IVM medium.
Remove cumulus cells from oocytes using hyaluronidase solution.
Check first polar body extrusion.
